Senses.PreferredTarget: The Accord of Difference and Sameness
AlternateTargets: Shitou's Accord of Difference and Sameness
Senses.Explanation: The title combines participation or joining (參), sameness (同), and accord or tally (契). In the Chan corpus it is the proper name of Shitou Xiqian's verse. The Transmission of the Lamp says that Shitou wrote it, calls its language deep, and prints the work under his name. Its opening says that the mind of the great Indian immortal is intimately transmitted east and west (竺土大仙心，東西密相付); its closing tells the person investigating the mystery to meet the source on hearing words and not waste the daylight (承言須會宗，勿自立規矩……謹白參玄人，光陰莫虗度). Fayan Wenyi later invokes the title in hall discourse, calls it a piece of wording, and quotes its opening. The Joint Essentials of the Lamps connects Shitou's composition with his reading that the sage has no self and nothing is not himself (聖人無己，靡所不己). Zen bends the phrase into a lineage-specific bibliographic name: these records use it not for a general agreement but for Shitou's transmitted Chan poem and for quotations from that poem.
Senses.Note: The corpus has 88 exact occurrences in 50 allowlisted files. Four exact title occurrences and one quoted-family witness establish authorship, title use, later deployment, and transmitted wording. The evidence still denotes one work; no second referent was found.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師著參同契一篇。辭旨幽𤀹頗有注解大行於世。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄) biography of Shitou Xiqian says that he wrote one Accord of Difference and Sameness (參同契) and that explanations of it circulated widely.

Occurrences.Kwic: 南嶽石頭和尚參同契南嶽石頭和尚參同契竺土大仙心。東西密相付。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄) prints the Accord of Difference and Sameness (參同契) under Shitou Xiqian's name and preserves its opening line.

Occurrences.Kwic: 有一片言語喚作參同契。末上云。竺土大僊心無過此語也。中間也只隨時說話。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄) hall discourse, Fayan Wenyi calls the Accord of Difference and Sameness (參同契) a piece of wording and quotes its opening.

Occurrences.Kwic: 石頭初看肇論，至會萬物為己者，其惟聖人乎，則曰：聖人無己，靡所不己。乃作參同契
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Joint Essentials of the Lamps (聯燈會要) discourse, Fayan Wenyi recounts that Shitou composed the Accord of Difference and Sameness (參同契) after reading the cited saying.

Occurrences.Kwic: 承言須會宗，勿自立規矩。觸目不會道，運足焉知路。進步非近遠，迷隔山河固。謹白參玄人，光陰莫虗度。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Weilin's Lodging Hermitage Draft (為霖禪師旅泊菴稿) prints Shitou Xiqian's closing lines, including the instruction not to waste daylight; this is a family witness because the title itself is absent.
